errata.orig:
OAuth registration client metadata names and descriptions are
registered by
errata.correct: OAuth token introspection response parameters are registered by
errata.notes: The original text erroneously mentions registration of client metadata names, however, this RFC 7662 is about about token introspection and this section is about registration of token introspection response parameters (client metadata name registration is RFC 7591).

errata.orig: a given token has been issued by this authorization server, has not been revoked by the resource owner, and is within its given time window of validity
errata.correct: a given token has been issued by this authorization server, has not been revoked by the resource owner or client, and is within its given time window of validity
errata.notes: RFC 7009 defined a given token can be revoke by client, so should write client here.
